environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI

environmentVariables.description: The default answer format of the app tools: snapshot (default) or adaptive-card (the snapshot plus an Adaptive Card 1.5 as an embedded resource, for card-rendering hosts).
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for no network: no UI5 CDN fallback, no GitHub mirror, no registry lookup.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_OFFLINE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to switch off the read-only GitHub mirror used when no checkout is found.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE

environmentVariables.description: Cache directory of the GitHub mirror. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-remote.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: How long a mirrored copy is used before it is refreshed, in milliseconds. Default: one day.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: How many MB of UI5 answers from the CDN (sdk.openui5.org) run_app and interact_app keep in memory across calls, so a second boot does not download them again. 0 switches the cache off. Default: 64.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI5_CACHE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Pages (Chromium tabs) of validate_view's warm render gate, which concurrent calls queue on. Default: 2 (1 to 8).
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_RENDER_PAGES

environmentVariables.description: Chromium binary for run_app and interact_app. Default: CHROMIUM_BIN, Playwright's managed browser, then a system chromium.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_CHROMIUM

environmentVariables.description: Where run_app and interact_app write their PNGs (the newest 50 are kept) and build_backend its log. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-screenshots.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCREENSHOT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Where build_backend mode prebuilt downloads the backend from. Default: the framework's release asset.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_PREBUILT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to run every lint as a fresh abaplint process. Default: a long-lived worker keeps @abaplint/core with the framework parsed and lints a deploy in milliseconds (the CLI runs whenever the worker cannot stand in for it).
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_WORKER

environmentVariables.description: How long the warm lint worker (about 300 MB with the framework parsed) is kept without a request before it exits, in milliseconds; the next lint starts a fresh one. 0 keeps it for the server's life. Default: 10 minutes.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_IDLE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of the abaplint run, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of scope_of, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCOPE_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of a build, the prebuilt download and the npm install, in milliseconds. Default: 30 minutes.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of the ABAP Unit runner, in milliseconds. Default: 10 minutes.
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_UNIT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Switches on the SYSTEM MODE: the app tools against this real SAP system instead of the sandbox loop. The launch URL, e.g. https://host:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}&sap-client=100.

environmentVariables.description: System mode: the SAP user the app tools log on with (Basic authentication).
environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER

environmentVariables.description: System mode: the password of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER. Or A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD, to keep it out of the configuration.
